label: Figure 13.3: Long-term output and output gaps
alt: Real GDP against time: a wavy actual output curve oscillates around a rising straight long-term trend line. At point A actual output is below the trend and at point B above it, marked by double-headed arrows.
caption: Actual output (the wavy curve) fluctuates around the long-term trend, which is potential output. At point A actual output is below the trend, a negative output gap (spare capacity); at point B it is above the trend, a positive output gap (the economy is overheating). The double-headed arrows show the size of each gap.
